Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files on user's hard drive via user-mode encrypter module, encrypting MFT table, and rewriting MBR with custom bootloader
Using Bitcoin mixing service (tumbler) to hide tracks via micro-transactions
Discoverer: Security experts monitoring Bitcoin wallet transactions and ransomware outbreak
Impacted Systems: User hard drives (files and MFT sectors)
Indicators of Compromise: PasteBin and DeepPaste text sharing services
Dark Web portal running Mattermost chat application
Ransom note shown in custom bootloader CLI-like interface
